name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.79 / build 80 updates clinic and Staff Support hours to 7:00 AM–5:00 PM daily (Asia/Manila). Staff messaging is available only during those hours; saved conversations remain readable and can be ended after hours. Removes booking, home-service and queue navigation and guidance, refreshes clinic FAQs and notices, and allows tapping outside chat to minimize without clearing the conversation. SMAPE/MAPE medical forms and saved records are preserved. Requires the matching Staff Support hours backend. Existing development/test signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval. Install over a compatible existing app without uninstalling or clearing app data. Physical-phone installation and actual patient push delivery were not verified.
